bio: Software engineer and QA specialist based in Cluj-Napoca, pursuing a Master's in Entrepreneurship at UTCN. I build dependable backend systems, craft thorough automated test suites, and provide meticulous PC/laptop hardware and thermal maintenance.

about.summary: Hi, I'm Dragoș! I'm a software engineer and QA specialist based in Cluj-Napoca, currently completing my Master's degree in Entrepreneurship at the Technical University of Cluj-Napoca (UTCN). I love building software that is reliable by design—from concurrent Java microservices and resilient Cypress/Selenium test harnesses to native C++ hardware benchmarking utilities. Alongside software development, I offer hands-on hardware thermal maintenance and system optimization across Cluj, making sure devices stay whisper-quiet and operate at peak performance.
highlights: Backend & fullstack engineering with Java, Spring Boot, and multithreaded concurrent task queues.
Comprehensive QA automation expertise across Cypress (TypeScript API intercepts) and Selenium (Java E2E testing).
Native systems programming and benchmarking in C++, analyzing real-time CPU throttling, memory latency, and SSD I/O.
Master's in Entrepreneurship at UTCN (2025–2027), uniting clean engineering practices with product strategy and transparent client service.
